card.title: PS5 Power Rails, Regulators, and Component Short Diagnostics

claims.statement: The TPS53219A single buck controller generates the +5V STBY rail from the +12V power supply.
claims.quote: This power regulator will generate +5v STBY. It is created from the +12V power supply.

claims.statement: If the real-time clock battery voltage drop is abnormal or 1k resistor drops incorrectly, a short is draining the clock battery, potentially indicating a faulty Southbridge.
claims.evidence: RTC battery circuit resistance and voltage drop checks.
claims.quote: Voltage drop must be low, else there is a short draining the clock battery, maybe southbridge is faulty.

claims.statement: RAM or SSD module issues can cause update errors or reboots during or after the update process.
claims.evidence: Behavioral correlation with RAM/SSD faults during software updates.
claims.quote: When you can’t update PS5 and during the update process or after the update it reboots then the cause can be RAM related.

procedure: Isolate Vcore circuit by lifting output coils to find shorted MOSFETs.
Check capacitors and fuses across 12V input, 1.9V power rail, 1.1V power rail, and WiFi IC for shorts.
Verify working SSD circuit current draw against expected 310mA benchmark.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Isolating power rails by lifting coils requires careful thermal management to avoid lifting board pads.
card.caveats: Always verify input power supplies can deliver necessary startup amperage (such as 30 Amps on 12V rail) before diagnosing downstream drops.
